coverage_notes.limitations: Twelve targeted web searches covered hospital/ED, maternity, rural emergency, ambulance, air-medical, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, reopening and territories. Search discovery is not exhaustive and results include stale, non-US, conditional and unrelated matches. Production collector data was not inspected for full item-level deduplication; prior recall and previous verified watch heartbeat were considered.
coverage_notes.controls: Created exactly one private watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; no approvals, public publication, source collector changes, schedule edits or task disabling.
